prompt: One single unbroken cinematic shot, no cuts. In deep near-black space with faint, distant galaxy dust and subtle volumetric depth, two monumental faces in profile face each other across the frame. On the left, a human face formed entirely of warm amber living matter: thousands of softly glowing organic particles and fine filaments that drift and breathe slowly. On the right, a machine intelligence face formed entirely of cool ice-white and pale blue precision: hair-thin engineered lines, luminous geometric facets and tiny travelling pulses of light, perfectly symmetrical, made of pure light with no metal and no plastic. The camera pushes forward very slowly in a straight line, steady and smooth, with minimal sideways drift and no orbit. At first the two faces hold still, regarding each other across a deep gulf of darkness. Then they begin to drift toward each other, slowly and inevitably. As the distance closes, the exchange begins: amber particles stream across and weave into the ice-blue lines, warming them into soft organic curves, while fine blue lines thread into the amber face, ordering it into crystalline precision. At the climax the two faces meet and pass through each other, and the frame holds one single face made of both — living and engineered at once, one being, glowing softly in amber and ice-white as a gentle pulse of light travels outward through it. Epic in scale, slow, deliberate, elegant. Photoreal macro detail in the particles and lines, luxury film grade, high contrast, deep blacks. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no holograms, no screens, no grid squares, no metal or plastic robot parts, no explosions, no flashes, no lens flares, no purple or magenta.
